mapper.sql: CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' ELSE 'CLEAR' END

(SELECT 'GW-H' AS source_kind,event_seq,event_grade,event_yn,event_dt,event_edt,event_msg,ems_id,device_id FROM raw_event_log UNION ALL SELECT 'WEB-P' AS source_kind,PERF_EVENT_SN AS event_seq, CAST(EVENT_GRADE AS CHAR) AS event_grade,1 AS event_yn, EVENT_DT AS event_dt,EVENT_EDT AS event_edt, CONCAT(CASE WHEN PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN 'CPU' ELSE 'MEMORY' END, ' 사용률 ',LAST_VALUE,'% 임계치 초과') AS event_msg, EMS_ID AS ems_id,DEVICE_ID AS device_id FROM web_perf_thrshld_event) D

LEFT JOIN com_device_info E ON E.ems_id=D.ems_id AND E.device_id=D.device_id LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=((SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=D.ems_id))

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel M JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=M.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND G.USE_YN='Y' JOIN web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info X ON X.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND X.USE_YN='Y' WHERE M.EMS_ID=D.ems_id AND M.DEVICE_ID=D.device_id AND D.event_dt >= X.BGNG_DT AND (X.NO_END_YN='Y' OR X.END_DT IS NULL OR D.event_dt <= X.END_DT) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AND R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD=CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' END)) AND (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN='ONCE' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' AND (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|DAILY|%' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|WEEKLY|%' AND FIND_IN_SET(ELT(WEEKDAY(D.event_dt)+1,'MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT','SUN'), SUBSTRING_INDEX(X.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',-1)) > 0) OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|MONTHLY|%' AND DAYOFMONTH(D.event_dt)=DAYOFMONTH(X.BGNG_DT))) AND (X.REPT_START_TM IS NULL OR X.REPT_END_TM IS NULL OR (X.REPT_START_TM <= X.REPT_END_TM AND TIME(D.event_dt) BETWEEN X.REPT_START_TM AND X.REPT_END_TM) OR (X.REPT_START_TM > X.REPT_END_TM AND (TIME(D.event_dt) >= X.REPT_START_TM OR TIME(D.event_dt) <= X.REPT_END_TM))))) )
WHERE D.event_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.event_dt < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

WHERE 1=1
AND D.event_dt >= CONCAT(#{selectedDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.event_dt < DATE_ADD(#{selectedDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND D.event_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.event_dt < DATE_ADD(#{endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY)

AND D.event_yn=1 AND D.event_grade IN ('1','2','3','4','5')
AND D.ems_id IN #{id}
AND D.event_dt >= CONCAT(#{selectedDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.event_dt < DATE_ADD(#{selectedDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND D.event_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.event_dt < DATE_ADD(#{endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_NOCS, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade IN ('1','2')),0) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, 0 AS SERVICE_NOCS, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_edt IS NOT NULL),0) AS COMPLETE_NOCS, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN D.event_edt IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.event_dt,D.event_edt) END)),0) AS AVG_RECOVERY_SEC, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100*SUM(D.event_edt IS NOT NULL)/COUNT(*),1) END AS COMPLETE_RATE FROM

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(D.event_dt,'%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, COUNT(*) AS totalNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='1') AS emergencyNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='2') AS highNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='3') AS lowNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='4') AS warningNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='5') AS infoNocs FROM
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(D.event_dt,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY reportDate

SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, COUNT(D.event_seq) AS totalNocs, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='1'),0) AS emergencyNocs, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='2'),0) AS highNocs, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='3'),0) AS lowNocs, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='4'),0) AS warningNocs, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='5'),0) AS infoNocs FROM web_link_sys_info L LEFT JOIN ON D.ems_id=(SELECT SM.ems_id FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.link_sys_cd=L.LINK_SYS_CD)
WHERE L.USE_YN='Y' AND L.LINK_SYS_CD IN (SELECT link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map) AND L.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} AND (SELECT SM.ems_id FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.link_sys_cd=L.LINK_SYS_CD) IN #{id} GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY (SELECT sort_seq FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.link_sys_cd=L.LINK_SYS_CD)

SELECT COALESCE(S.STN_CD,'UNMATCHED') AS stnCd, COALESCE(S.STN_NM,'역사 미매핑') AS stnNm, COUNT(*) AS totalNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='1') AS emergencyNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='2') AS highNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='3') AS lowNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='4') AS warningNocs, SUM(D.event_grade='5') AS infoNocs FROM
GROUP BY S.STN_CD,S.STN_NM,S.STN_SEQ ORDER BY CASE WHEN S.STN_SEQ IS NULL THEN 999 ELSE S.STN_SEQ END

SELECT CONCAT(D.source_kind,'-',D.event_seq) AS dsbltyNo, COALESCE(S.STN_NM,'역사 미매핑') AS stnNm, COALESCE(L.LINK_SYS_NM,CONCAT('EMS ',D.ems_id)) AS linkSysNm, COALESCE(E.device_nm,D.device_id) AS eqpmntNm, E.device_ip AS ipAddr, DATE_FORMAT(D.event_dt,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS ocrnDt, DATE_FORMAT(D.event_edt,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS transferEndDt, CASE WHEN D.event_edt IS NOT NULL AND D.event_edt >= D.event_dt THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.event_dt,D.event_edt) ELSE NULL END AS durationSec, AS gradeCd, D.event_msg AS faultCn FROM
ORDER BY D.event_dt DESC,D.event_seq DESC LIMIT 500
